specialisations_defined.Melee: 1H (one-handed weapons: vibroblades, vibroknives, stun batons, axes, clubs, swords and improvised weapons held in one hand), 2H (weapons that need both hands: vibro-axes, force pikes, electrostaffs, quarterstaffs and other great weapons), Brawling (unarmed strikes, knuckle-dusters, shock gloves, grapples and wrestling; also used to defend when you have no weapon), \*Lightsaber (all lightsabers, including double-bladed sabers and lightsaber pikes; −20 unless you have Force Sensitive). A weapon used with the wrong Specialisation is Tested on bare Weapon Skill (see [[SL100:Combat|Combat]]). Careers and Origins write a choice of Specialisations with slashes, e.g. Melee (1H/2H): you pick one and record it as a single skill, e.g. Melee (1H). Only careers with a Force tradition offer Lightsaber.

specialisations_defined.Ranged: Archaic (bows, crossbows, slings, slugthrowers, bowcasters and any other projectile weapon that must be aimed rather than pointed), Blaster (every hand-held blaster from hold-out pistols to blaster rifles and repeating blasters, together with ion, disruptor and sonic weapons: the skill for any futuristic personal weapon and the standard ranged skill of the galaxy), Exotic (nets and net launchers, whips used at range, flame projectors, glue and adhesive projectors, dart and flechette launchers, wrist-mounted weapons, Mandalorian mini-rockets and other unusual ranged weapons), Ordnance (large, heavy and turreted weapons: missile and rocket launchers, grenade launchers, mortars, the E-Web and other crew-served or tripod weapons, and the turreted and mounted guns of vehicles and starships: for simplicity every starship weapon uses this skill), Thrown (grenades, thermal detonators, throwing knives, darts, spears and anything else hurled by hand). Careers and Origins write a choice with slashes, e.g. Ranged (Blaster/Ordnance). A weapon used with the wrong Specialisation is Tested on bare Ballistic Skill with the weapon's penalties (see [[SL100:Combat|Combat]]).
